scope: Two deterministic, offline adversarial reproductions; neither executes live Redis Lua or measures service performance.

budgets.messagePackAllocation: Intercepted before allocation; declared length only 131072 elements.

cases.name: truncated MessagePack array32 metadata allocates before rejection
cases.fixture: HC1M followed by 0xdd and big-endian unsigned length 131072, with no elements
cases.expected: Strict internal decoding rejects the truncated container before attempting a declared-size array allocation.
cases.method: Replace global Array temporarily with a Proxy that throws only for the fixture's declared size; restore it in finally.

cases.name: initial coordination outage fallback overwrites a newer protected publication
cases.fixture: Two L1-disabled HybridCache instances, two RedisStore v2 adapters, one local AuditRedis protocol double, no event bus
schedule: A acquireLock rejects with simulated initial coordination outage
A starts its fallback loader and pauses
B acquires a lease and publishes winner
Read authoritative state through B's RedisStore
cases.expected: A may return its fail-open loader value, but cannot overwrite or prime state protected by B's newer lease.
cases.sourceAtBaseline: src/cache/hybridCache.ts:849 initial failure fallback and :741 ordinary publication compatibility path
cases.cleanup: Release paused loader in finally, close both caches, clear protocol-double values, clear hard deadline.

limitations: These are correctness counterexamples, not throughput or memory-per-entry measurements.
The Redis double implements command contracts but does not establish failover, Cluster or network-partition guarantees.
Final readiness requires re-testing the completed build and reviewing final changes.
